test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A grocer marked his goods at 70% above the cost price and sold them at a discount of X%. If he gained 53% profit, then find the value of X
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = 100 (assuming)

Marked Price (MP) = 70% above CP = 100 + 70 = 170

Discount = X%

Profit = 53%

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit = 100 + 53 = 153

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = Marked Price × (1 - Discount/100)

**Calculation:**

SP = MP × (1 - Discount/100)

⇒ 153 = 170 × (1 - X/100)

⇒ 153 / 170 = 1 - X/100

⇒ 0.9 = 1 - X/100

⇒ X/100 = 1 - 0.9

⇒ X/100 = 0.1

⇒ X = 0.1 × 100

⇒ X = 10

**The value of X is 10%.**
